topic: Write a Postcard from a Trip(写一张旅行明信片)
genre: 明信片 / 记叙(describe where you are + what you have done + plans)
source: 外研社版必修第二册 Unit 5 Writing:write a postcard to a friend(描述你所在的地方、做了什么、接下来的计划),自然运用 -ing 分词作定语。
prompt_cn: 假设你叫李华,正在外地旅行。请用英语给你的朋友 Sam 写一张约80词的明信片,内容包括:① 你现在在哪里、那里的风景或天气怎样;② 你到目前为止做了什么、印象最深的一件事;③ 接下来打算做什么。注意:适当使用 -ing 分词作定语(如 the rising sun, a path leading to the beach),语言地道连贯。
prompt_en: Suppose you are Li Hua, travelling away from home. Write a postcard (about 80 words) to your friend Sam, including: 1) where you are now and what the scenery or weather is like; 2) what you have done so far and the moment that impressed you most; 3) what you plan to do next. Try to use -ing participles as attributives (e.g. the rising sun, a path leading to the beach).
points: 说明地点与风景/天气(I'm now in… / The scenery here is…)
已做的事 + 印象最深的瞬间(So far I've… / The best moment was…)
下一步计划(Tomorrow we're going to…)
用 -ing 分词作定语,语言连贯
model_essay: Dear Sam, Greetings from the seaside town of Brighton! I'm sitting on a beach now, watching the setting sun turn the sky pink. So far I've walked along a quiet path leading to the harbour and taken hundreds of photos of the passing boats. The best moment was seeing a group of dolphins swimming close to the shore — amazing! Tomorrow we're going to hike up the hill for a view of the whole bay. The scenery here is breathtaking. Wish you were here! Love, Li Hua
model_translation: 亲爱的 Sam:来自海滨小镇布莱顿的问候!我正坐在沙滩上,看着西沉的太阳把天空染成粉色。到目前为止,我沿着一条通往港口的安静小路散步,拍了好几百张驶过的船的照片。最难忘的瞬间是看到一群海豚游到岸边——太棒了!明天我们打算爬上山,饱览整个海湾的景色。这里的风景美极了。真希望你也在这儿!爱你的,李华

rubric.criteria: 三要素齐全:地点/风景 · 已做的事与难忘瞬间 · 下一步计划
明信片格式(问候+正文+落款)、句句连贯、时态得当(现在/现在完成/将来)
词汇句型准确多样、-ing 分词作定语运用自然、语法基本无误

required_structure: 问候/地点 Greetings from… / I'm now in…
已做的事 So far I've…
难忘瞬间 The best moment was…
计划 Tomorrow we're going to…
落款 Wish you were here! Love, Li Hua
key_expressions: Greetings from the seaside town of Brighton!
I'm watching the setting sun turn the sky pink.
I've walked along a path leading to the harbour.
Tomorrow we're going to hike up the hill for a view of the bay.

high_sentences: I'm sitting on a beach, watching the setting sun turn the sky pink.
I've walked along a quiet path leading to the harbour.
I took hundreds of photos of the passing boats.
The best moment was seeing a group of dolphins swimming close to the shore.

error_pairs.wrong: a path led to the harbour
error_pairs.correct: a path leading to the harbour
error_pairs.note: 后置定语表主动用 -ing 分词,不用过去式 led。
太阳主动'西沉',前置定语用 -ing,不用 -ed。

error_pairs.wrong: It was a very amazed view.
error_pairs.correct: It was a very amazing view.
error_pairs.note: 事物令人惊叹用 -ing;人感到惊叹才用 -ed。

paragraph_template:
【旅行明信片结构】

正文1 地点风景:The scenery here is… , with the rising sun / a path leading to…
正文2 已做+难忘:So far I've… The best moment was…
正文3 计划:Tomorrow we're going to…
落款:Wish you were here! Love, 李华
